key_facts: Gabriel Bortoleto, driver of Car 5 for Audi Revolut F1 Team, moved his car under braking (while slowing down) into Turn 5 during the race at the 2026 Spanish Grand Prix.
His car impacted Car 43, forcing Car 43 to leave the track.
This was a breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 e) of the FIA International Sporting Code, which prohibits unsportsmanlike or dangerous driving.
The Stewards issued a Warning (the equivalent of a black/white flag, a penalty for continued unsportsmanlike conduct).
plain_explanation: At the 2026 Spanish Grand Prix on 13 September, Gabriel Bortoleto (Car 5, Audi Revolut F1 Team) received a Warning during the race. The Stewards found that his car moved under braking as it approached Turn 5 and hit Car 43, which had to leave the track as a result. This breached the rule against unsportsmanlike driving. The baseline penalty for this kind of infringement is a black/white flag (a warning that continued offences can lead to further penalties), and the Stewards issued a Warning, which counts as equivalent to this flag.
